response.sql: WITH team_rates AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_team_rate FROM team_rates) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_team_rate AS difference FROM team_rates AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A record with zero games has an undefined win rate and is excluded from the average; it still counts as a record.
